answer: Re-attestations are stored in beacon and signal lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the dawn graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1774 impostors cost 1623 times the honest price and take 13 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
